subject: FY2023 Property Tax Rate Allocation
overview: The Council held a public hearing on the fiscal year 2023 property tax rate and reviewed several ARPA-funded technology and infrastructure projects. Public testimony addressed concerns regarding student safety and administrative accountability following a recent assault at Medford High School.

items.title: Routine Business and Recognitions
items.summary: Approved condolences for Edward Buddy Clayton, recognized Margaret Maggie Giordano’s 100th birthday, approved the November 15 minutes, and granted a common victualler license to Eddie's Place.

items.title: Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved the Committee of the Whole report regarding Paid Family Medical Leave and referred a Subcommittee on Housing report regarding the Housing Stability Notification Ordinance to the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: FY2023 Property Tax Allocation Hearing
items.summary: Tabled the public hearing on fiscal year 2023 property tax allocation for one week following a presentation on the proposed 175% shift in the residential factor and split tax rate.

items.title: Infrastructure and Health Resolutions
items.summary: Tabled a discussion on substandard Winthrop Street paving to invite utility representatives, and approved resolutions addressing Senior Center heating repairs and modern rodent control technology.

items.title: Plan Development District Fee Schedule
items.summary: Referred a resolution regarding the establishment of a fee schedule for Plan Development District proposals to the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Public Participation: School Safety
items.summary: Heard testimony from a resident regarding a violent bullying incident at Medford High School and requested administrative accountability regarding safety protocols and legal deadlines for paperwork.

items.title: ARPA Project Presentations
items.summary: Received and placed on file presentations regarding five ARPA-funded projects exceeding $250,000, including a dedicated fiber optic network for the fire department and municipal IT support upgrades.

items.title: Clarification of ARPA Appropriation Authority
items.summary: Passed a request for a formal response from the administration as to whether the Council will be required to vote on individual ARPA appropriations exceeding $250,000.
